guard: an uninjected --dev-mint daemon signs its dev cred with the account of the space it serves, never the root's sole space
why: The --dev-mint branch picked its signer with soleSpaceOf while the daemon served --space, so a
two-space root refused a correct --space and a root holding one other space signed the cred with
that space's account. The child runs bin/cotal.ts, which loads the delivery package's dist, so the
command rebuilds it and afterRestore rebuilds it again from the restored source.

mutations.name: dev-mint picks the root's sole space instead of the served one
mutations.replace: const sole = soleSpaceOf(authDir(root)); const auth = sole ? loadSpaceAuth(authDir(root), sole) : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: --space b --dev-mint on a two-space root signs with b's account
mutations.cell: --space b --dev-mint on a two-space root signs with b's account
